chapter: Early life and training in Boston
title: His mother's death and his father's hotel work
summary: His mother dies in his freshman year of high school, and he says his father was a headwaiter at Boston hotels and a cafeteria.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And then in the first -- I mean, freshman in high school, my mother died and my father had just built a house across the street and she didn't even live to enter it, and
that was my freshman year in 1910, 1908.
What kind of business was your father in.

My father, oh,he was headwaiter at the Belleview Hotel and then he went to the Young's Hotel and then from there he went to the cafeteria up in Boston. Anyway it was -- Pat Toy used to play there, Pat Toy Trio.
